app.name: Luffy
app.one_liner: A Go-based CLI media streaming tool that enables cross-platform playback of movies and TV shows without requiring a browser.

screens.name: Main Media Selector
screens.purpose: Display search results and allow user to select media for playback or download.
primary_actions: Search for movies or TV shows

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Download and save a selected media item to local storage, handling segmented downloads and partial file cleanup on failure.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add mpv playback support with configurable args
week 1: Implement core CLI interface for media search and selection
acceptance_tests: User can install Luffy via Nix or APT and successfully stream a movie on Linux.
When megacloud client key extraction fails, the system provides a clear error instead of hanging.
